name: Dual-incomer parallel-closing interlock
summary: Restricts simultaneous incomer connection when the installation is not designed for source paralleling.
description: Restricts simultaneous incomer connection when the installation is not designed for source paralleling. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two incomer positions” at the input and “Parallel-close blocking” at the output. The bus-tie state changes the possible source paths.
